oliver (PM): Heads-up: during QA a customer reported the Console saved-view list showing a saved-query pinned to model `m-large` but the preview cost shows the cheaper `m-small` numbers. That mismatch is confusing. Need API+UX contract to make effective model, pinned model, and preview costs explicit.

drew (eng): Can you paste the exact UI state? Was it the list or the restore modal?

oliver (PM): List + hover preview. The saved item says `Pinned: m-large` badge, but hover shows `Est. 1.2k tokens` which matches `m-small`.

riley (design): UX principle: show both "pinned" and "effective" values whenever they diverge. Badge: `Pinned: m-large`. Inline line: `Effective: m-small (fallback) • Est +1.2k tokens` with a small info icon.

sunita (platform): Backend already returns `requested_model_id` and `active_model_id` for live allocations, but saved-query endpoints only return `model_id`. We need to extend saved-query preview endpoint to return `requested_model_id`, `effective_model_id`, `preview_cost_tokens`, and `fallback_reason`. Flat fields to keep clients simple.

drew (eng): Agreed. Suggested shape: `model_requested`, `model_effective`, `preview_cost_tokens`, `fallback_reason` (enum: capacity|compatibility|quantization). Keep strings + numeric.

tom (sre): Telemetry: add `saved_query.preview` event with fields `query_id`, `org_id`, `model_requested`, `model_effective`, `preview_cost_tokens`. Sample at 100% for rollout. Also add alert when `model_effective != model_requested` for >1% of restores in 5m.

oliver (PM): Rollout: (1) API adds fields read-only, (2) Console surfaces mismatch UI but keeps restore behavior unchanged, (3) 7-day shadow telemetry for 20% orgs, (4) after metrics good, enable confirm modal when mismatch.

riley (design): Confirm modal (only when mismatch & delta>10%): "This saved view requests m-large but will use m-small due to availability. Estimated cost difference: +{X} tokens. [Switch anyway] [Apply filters only]". Add link "Why did this change?" to open details.

sunita (platform): Backward compat: keep `model_id` field for 14 days. Add header `X-SQ-Preview:v1` for the preview API. We'll include `preview_request_id` so UI can correlate preview->commit events.

drew (eng): Client work: map new fields, show badge + inline effective note, add feature flag `sq_preview_mismatch` to gate confirm modal. Tests: contract tests to verify header present.

tom (sre): I'll create dashboard: mismatch rate by org + median token delta. Pager: if mismatch rate >1% and median delta >20% fire `sq_preview_mismatch_alert`.

ui-bot: deploy-preview started for `platform/sq-preview-shim` at 2026-03-23T16:00:00Z

oliver (PM): Action items: sunita PR today, riley mocks by EOD, drew client mapping + flag, tom dashboards/alerts. We'll reconvene after deploy-preview. :thumbsup:
